On garden walk 1, Mira stopped beside the brass telescope. The path curved around a pool of rainwater, and the city sounded distant beyond the wall. She recorded the shape of a leaf, then waited for the wind to turn it. There was no prize for finishing first. Reading the notes slowly revealed what yesterday had hidden.

The evening notebook
At dusk, Mira compared the new pages with the old notebook. She had counted fewer things and noticed more. The telescope remained by the window, ready for another clear night.
